verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Treasury accounts can hold USD, EUR and GBP balances and send outbound payments. It never documents international wires, SWIFT, FX conversion with transparent rates, or a currency/corridor coverage map. Holding several currencies is an adjacent capability and does not show money moving across borders.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented
